body:
Source: GitHub issue #783 (documentation, P3-low, area:tickets). Re-verified on main @ b4cff43c: `packages/ticket-prune/README.md` flag table, `--json` row, documents `{ baseRef, write, ceremony, inferScope, stale[], active[], tombstoned[], ceremonyCompleted[], needsCeremony[] }`, but `toJson()` in `lib/format.mjs` returns `{ baseRef, write, ceremony, inferScope, stale, active, tombstoned, archived, ceremonyCompleted, needsCeremony, blocked }`. The row omits `archived` (the directory-store mutation record: tickets `--write` moved out of the active store) and `blocked` (the skip-and-continue set), and advertises `ceremonyCompleted`, which is permanently empty since `--ceremony` was deprecated (#208). `docs/tools/ticket-prune.md` carries the same stale row; `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/ticket-prune.mdx` carries a DIFFERENT incomplete subset, `{ baseRef, write, inferScope, stale[], active[], archived[] }`. A consumer written against the documented schema on a sharded store sees `tombstoned: []` and concludes nothing changed while `archived` holds the removed tickets.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/ticket-prune`: `bin/ticket-prune.mjs` (CLI), `lib/run.mjs` (orchestration, produces the result object), `lib/format.mjs` (`renderReport` text, `toJson` machine shape), `lib/detect.mjs` (staleness classification), `lib/store.mjs` (store backends), `lib/archive-order.mjs` (archive ordering / blocked set). Tests: `npm test -w packages/ticket-prune` from the worktree root. `test/format.test.mjs` already pins `toJson`'s projection and is a rail.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. Docs follow code: `toJson` is the contract and does not change. No edit to `lib/` or `bin/`.
2. The `--json` row in all three docs files lists exactly the keys `toJson` returns, in `toJson`'s order, with a `[]` suffix on exactly the keys whose value is an array: `{ baseRef, write, ceremony, inferScope, stale[], active[], tombstoned[], archived[], ceremonyCompleted[], needsCeremony[], blocked[] }`.
3. The same row (or a sentence directly under the flag table) states, identically in all three files: `archived[]` is the tickets `--write` moved out of the active directory store; `tombstoned[]` is the legacy `.adlc/tickets.json` in-place tombstones; `blocked[]` is stale tickets left unarchived because a ticket outside the batch still references them; `ceremony` is always `false` and `ceremonyCompleted[]` always empty since `--ceremony` was deprecated (#208), both retained for compatibility. Verify each of these four statements against `lib/run.mjs`, `lib/store.mjs` and `lib/archive-order.mjs` before writing it; if the code says otherwise, the code wins and the statement changes.
4. A new drift-guard test, `packages/ticket-prune/test/json-shape-docs.test.mjs`, reads the `--json` row from each of the three files, extracts the brace-delimited key list, and asserts it equals the keys of `toJson()` applied to a minimal result, with `[]` exactly on array-valued keys. It must fail if a key is added to `toJson` without a docs update, or if a mirror drifts from the README.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 README `--json` row lists exactly the toJson keys in order with correct `[]` markers. verify: `node --test packages/ticket-prune/test/json-shape-docs.test.mjs`
- AC2 `docs/tools/ticket-prune.md` row matches. verify: `node --test packages/ticket-prune/test/json-shape-docs.test.mjs`
- AC3 `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/ticket-prune.mdx` row matches. verify: `node --test packages/ticket-prune/test/json-shape-docs.test.mjs`
- AC4 The drift guard is load-bearing: adding a key to toJson's returned object locally makes it fail. verify: temporarily add a key in `lib/format.mjs`, run `node --test packages/ticket-prune/test/json-shape-docs.test.mjs` (must fail), revert.
- AC5 The archived/tombstoned/blocked/ceremony statements are present in all three files. verify: `grep -c "always empty" packages/ticket-prune/README.md docs/tools/ticket-prune.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/ticket-prune.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC6 Existing suite green. verify: `npm test -w packages/ticket-prune`
- AC7 Mutation gate exits 0 on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12`

OUT OF SCOPE: any change to `toJson`, `renderReport` or the result object; the `--infer-scope` documentation (#779); other ticket-prune README sections; other open ticket-prune issues.
title: ticket-prune: document the full --json shape, including archived[] and blocked[]
